intro: Government and energy sectors bore the brunt of five living-off-the-land attacks between April 12 and May 14, 2026, with one critical and four high-severity incidents. Threat actors GopherWhisper, KongTuke, and Operation PhantomCLR were observed exploiting CVE-2023-36036, primarily targeting organizations in Asia, Central America, and South America. The campaign leveraged legitimate system tools to evade detection, posing significant risks to enterprise networks across the affected regions.
